rulebook: DHR Licensing and Performance Standards for Day Care Centers (eff. Sept. 13, 2021)

items.requirement: Written permission signed by each child's parent or guardian must be on file for each child participating in swimming or wading activities.
items.section: C. Facilities, 6. Swimming and Wading at the Center
items.quote: Written permission signed by each child's parent(s)/guardian(s) shall be on file in the center for each child participating in swimming or wading activities.

items.requirement: Before a child participates in away-from-center activities, a written statement signed by each parent or guardian must be on file.
items.section: C. Facilities, 7. Away from center activities
items.quote: IF THE CENTER PROVIDES ACTIVITIES AWAY FROM THE CENTER, A WRITTEN STATEMENT, SIGNED BY EACH CHILD'S PARENT(S)/GUARDIAN(S), SHALL BE ON FILE IN THE CENTER PRIOR TO THE CHILD'S PARTICIPATION IN SUCH ACTIVITIES.

items.requirement: Required staff-child ratios must be maintained at all times.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 1. Staffing
items.quote: Required ratios shall be maintained at all times.

items.requirement: Unless a physician specifies otherwise, each infant younger than twelve months must be placed in a supine position for sleeping.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 2. Infant/Toddler Daily Program
items.quote: unless the infant has a note from a physician specifying otherwise, each infant younger than twelve (12) months, shall be placed in a supine (on his/her back) position for sleeping to lower the risks of Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS).

items.requirement: Children in attendance must be served breakfast or a morning snack, a nutritious midday meal, and at least one afternoon snack.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 3. Preschool/School-age Children - Daily Program
items.quote: Children in attendance shall be served breakfast or a morning snack, a nutritious midday meal, and at least one (1) afternoon snack.

items.requirement: The use of corporal or physical punishment is prohibited.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 4. Disciplinary Practices
items.quote: The use of corporal or physical punishment is prohibited, including but not limited to spanking; shaking; slapping; kicking; pushing; biting; pinching; hitting; thumping; hair pulling; ear pulling; excessive physical exercise, excessive rest, or strenuous/ bizarre posture.

items.requirement: The use of verbal abuse is prohibited.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 4. Disciplinary Practices
items.quote: The use of verbal abuse is prohibited, including but not limited to: yelling; shouting; name calling; shaming; making derogatory remarks about a child or a child's family; using language that is inappropriate, offensive, threatens, humiliates, or frightens a child;

items.requirement: Discipline associated with food, naps, or bathroom procedures is prohibited.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 4. Disciplinary Practices
items.quote: The use of discipline associated with food, naps, or bathroom procedures is prohibited, including but not limited to: withholding food as punishment; use of food such as hot sauce, lemon juice, vinegar, etc., or soap, as punishment; punishment for lapses in toilet training; punishment for not sleeping during nap/rest time;

items.requirement: The use of physical restraint as punishment is prohibited.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 4. Disciplinary Practices
items.quote: The use of physical restraint as punishment is prohibited;

items.requirement: Punishment administered by another child is prohibited.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 4. Disciplinary Practices
items.quote: Punishment administered by another child is prohibited.

items.requirement: Rough or harsh handling of children is prohibited.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 4. Disciplinary Practices
items.quote: Rough or harsh handling of children, whether associated with discipline or not, is prohibited, including but not limited to: shaking; lifting or jerking by one or both arms; pushing; pulling; forcing or restricting movement; lifting or moving by grasping clothing; covering a child's head; etc.

items.requirement: Physical activity or outdoor time must not be taken away as punishment.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 4. Disciplinary Practices
items.quote: Physical activity/outdoor time taken away as punishment is prohibited.

items.requirement: No child who is ill shall be admitted to the center.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 6. Health Information
items.quote: No child who is ill shall be admitted to the center.

items.requirement: A child who becomes ill, has a contagious condition, or suffers an injury requiring professional medical attention must be separated promptly from the group with continuous supervision.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 6. Health Information
items.quote: Any child in attendance who becomes ill, has a contagious disease or condition, or suffers an injury that requires professional medical attention shall be separated promptly from the group, but shall have continuous supervision by a staff person.

items.requirement: The ill or injured child's parent or guardian must be notified immediately and required to come for or arrange for another designated person to come for the child.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 6. Health Information
items.quote: The ill or injured child's parent(s)/guardian(s) shall be notified immediately and required to come for or arrange for another designated person to come for the child.

items.requirement: The center must be open to visits from parents or guardians at any time during operating hours.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 5. Staff-Parent Communication
items.quote: The center shall be open to visits from parent(s)/guardian(s) at any time during the center's operating hours.

items.requirement: The center must notify parents or guardians of procedures for making a complaint, including the name or names of persons to contact.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 5. Staff-Parent Communication
items.quote: The center shall notify parent(s)/guardian(s) of procedures for making a complaint, including name(s) of person(s) to contact.

items.requirement: When a contagious disease or condition has been introduced into the center, parents or guardians of each exposed child must be notified.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 6. Health Information
items.quote: When a contagious disease/condition (a disease/condition which can be transmitted or spread from person to person) has been introduced into the center, parent(s)/guardian(s) of each exposed child shall be notified.

items.requirement: Each child with a food allergy should have a written care plan with avoidance instructions and a detailed treatment plan.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 6. Health Information
items.quote: Each child with a food allergy should have a written care plan that includes:

items.requirement: The center must submit its written disaster plan to the Department and provide copies to all parents or guardians.
items.section: D. Child Care Program, 7. Emergency Preparedness and Response Plans
items.quote: This emergency preparedness plan must be submitted to the Department and copies provided to all parents/guardians.

items.requirement: Before a child participates in center transportation or away-from-center activities, a written statement signed by each parent or guardian must be on file.
items.section: E. Transportation, 1. Transportation Provided by the Center
items.quote: IF THE CENTER PROVIDES TRANSPORTATION OR ANY ACTIVITIES AWAY FROM THE CENTER, A WRITTEN STATEMENT, SIGNED BY EACH CHILD'S PARENT(S)/GUARDIAN(S), SHALL BE ON FILE IN THE CENTER PRIOR TO THE CHILD'S PARTICIPATION IN SUCH ACTIVITIES.

items.requirement: Each child must be properly secured using an appropriate child passenger restraint system meeting applicable state and federal motor vehicle safety standards.
items.section: E. Transportation, 1. Transportation Provided by the Center
items.quote: Each child shall be properly secured using an aftermarket or integrated child passenger restraint system meeting applicable state and federal motor vehicle safety standards. Each child passenger restraint system shall be appropriate for the age and size of the child.

items.requirement: The center must require written authorization from a parent or guardian to release a child to any person other than the parent, guardian, or persons designated on the child's preadmission form.
items.section: E. Transportation, 2. Transportation Provided by Parent(s)/Guardian(s) or Other Designated Person(s)
items.quote: The center shall require written authorization from a child's parent(s)/guardian(s) to release a child to any person other than the parent(s)/guardian(s) or persons designated on the child's preadmission form.

items.requirement: The center must require unfamiliar authorized persons to show photographic identification when releasing a child.
items.section: E. Transportation, 2. Transportation Provided by Parent(s)/Guardian(s) or Other Designated Person(s)
items.quote: The center shall require unfamiliar authorized persons to show photographic identification when releasing a child.

items.requirement: The center must establish written operating policies, give a copy to parents at enrollment, submit a copy to the Department, and provide changes to parents and the Department.
items.section: H. Administration, 1. Applicant/Licensee
items.quote: Establish written operating policies of the center. (See page 89 for requirements)

items.requirement: The total number of children in care at any time must conform to the number specified on the license, permit, or approval.
items.section: H. Administration, 3. Admission Procedures
items.quote: The total number of the children in the care of the center at any given time, including children on the premises (inside and outside), children in transit, children on field trips, or other center activities, shall conform to that which is specified on the license, permit, or approval.

items.requirement: The age range of children in care at any time must conform to the limits specified on the license, permit, or approval.
items.section: H. Administration, 3. Admission Procedures
items.quote: The age range of the children in the care of the center at any given time, including children on the premises (inside and outside), children in transit, children on field trips, or other center activities, shall conform to that which is specified on the license, permit, or approval.

items.requirement: If the center accepts drop-in care, vacancies, ratios, records, and advance arrangements must all be maintained.
items.section: H. Administration, 3. Admission Procedures
items.quote: If the center accepts children for drop-in care, all of the following conditions shall be met:

items.requirement: Each staff person is required by law to report known or suspected child abuse or neglect to the County Department of Human Resources or local law enforcement.
items.section: H. Administration, 2. Reports to the Department
items.quote: Each staff person is required by law (Code of Alabama 1975) to report known or suspected child abuse or neglect (see definition, Section A., 6, page 7) to the County Department of Human Resources or the local chief of police, or county sheriff.

items.requirement: On the child's first day of attendance, each eligible child must have a valid State of Alabama Certificate of Immunization on file unless an exemption or homelessness documentation applies.
items.section: H. Administration, 4. Children's Records
items.quote: On the child's first day of attendance, each child from two (2) months of age to lawful school age and each child of lawful school age who is not enrolled in public or private school kindergarten shall have a valid State of Alabama Certificate of Immunization on file in the center, unless one of the following is on file in the center:

items.requirement: Children's records and information about children and their families must be kept confidential.
items.section: H. Administration, 4. Children's Records
items.quote: Children's records and information about children and their families shall be kept confidential.

items.requirement: Individual records on each child must be on file in the center on the child's first day of attendance.
items.section: H. Administration, 4. Children's Records
items.quote: Individual records on each child shall be on file in the center on the child's first day of attendance.

items.requirement: The written operating policies must include transportation policies if transportation is provided by the center.
items.section: Appendix K. Required items to be included in operating policies
items.quote: Transportation policies if provided by the center

items.requirement: The written operating policies must include the days and hours the center will be open.
items.section: Appendix K. Required items to be included in operating policies
items.quote: Days and hours the center will be open

items.requirement: The written operating policies must include emergency preparedness response plans.
items.section: Appendix K. Required items to be included in operating policies
items.quote: Emergency Preparedness Response Plans (see pages 35-36)

items.requirement: The written operating policies must include disciplinary procedures, including reasons for limited use of expulsion or suspension if used.
items.section: Appendix K. Required items to be included in operating policies
items.quote: Disciplinary procedures including reasons for limited use of expulsion or suspension if used.
